SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) / 
              (SELECT SUM(payment_value) FROM order_payments op 
               JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id 
               WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')), 2) AS pct_distintos_metodos_pago
FROM order_items oi
JOIN order_payments op ON oi.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE op.payment_type != 'boleto' AND op.payment_type != 'credit_card' 
      AND op.payment_type != 'debit_card' AND op.payment_type != 'not_defined' 
      AND op.payment_type != 'voucher'
